summary: Re-ran the full Lovli mobile E2E suite on the preview tunnel (390x844) against the live backend. The two big blockers from iteration_2 are FIXED: (1) bottom tab-bar overlay on primary CTAs no longer hijacks the Generate-replies tap once content is scrolled — TAB_BAR_SPACE=132 in Screen.tsx leaves a ~67px gap between button bottom and tab-bar top after scroll, so onPress on Reply/Pro/Memory/Settings CTAs reaches the correct handler (verified via toast 'Upload a screenshot or paste the chat first.', and via real reply generation); (2) open-settings-button (top-right gear) DOES navigate to /settings, settings-name-input shows 'Lovli Mobile Test', settings-save-button → toast 'Settings saved.', logout returns to /login. memory-empty testID now resolves correctly (GlassCard forwards data-testid). Reply generation E2E worked end-to-end (3 cards, usage='1 of 8 used today', Copy → 'Copied. Go send it.'). Pro waitlist worked (joined-block + toast). Memory Add and Edit worked (toasts 'Memory saved.' and 'Memory updated.', card visible with 'Matcha Plus'). ONE bug remaining: Memory Delete is broken on web because Alert.alert(multi-button) on react-native-web does NOT raise a confirm dialog and never invokes the destructive onPress — the DELETE /api/memory-cards/{id} request is never sent and the card stays. Also a Playwright-only quirk: real page.click on Pro Early Access button times out unless we scroll the ScrollView via mouse.wheel first (button natural y=907 > viewport 844). Real users on mobile can scroll, so this is a test-harness issue, not a user-facing regression — but it does mean primary CTAs near the screen bottom rely on the user scrolling first, which is acceptable.

ui_bugs.issue: Alert.alert with multiple buttons (Cancel + destructive Delete) is a no-op on react-native-web. No window.alert / window.confirm is shown, no dialog event is dispatched, and the 'Delete' button's onPress never fires. Result: tapping memory-delete-{id} on web does nothing — no API DELETE, no toast, no card removal. Verified by attaching page.on('dialog', ...) — zero dialog events were captured after clicking memory-delete. Fix: branch on Platform.OS — on 'web', call window.confirm(`Delete "${nickname}"?`) directly; on native, keep Alert.alert. Or render a custom themed confirm modal so behaviour is identical across platforms (also better for design).

integration_issues.issue: Never invoked on web because the confirmation step (Alert.alert) silently no-ops. Backend endpoint itself is fine; the failure is the missing client-side trigger on web.

issues: Primary CTAs (Generate replies, Get Early Access, Save Memory) sit below the initial viewport fold on a 390x844 viewport — user must scroll to reach them. Once scrolled, there is ~67px breathing room above the tab bar (good). Consider auto-scrolling to the CTA on load, OR making the CTA a sticky footer with paddingBottom matching the tab bar height, so first-time users don't miss it.

react_native_issues.issue: Alert.alert on web maps to window.alert (single OK) and ignores the button array. Any flow that relies on a destructive confirm (memory delete today; logout confirmation tomorrow if added; etc.) needs a Platform.OS guard or a custom modal.
Console warnings persist: 'shadow* style props are deprecated, use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated, use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking, RN-web only.

action_items: Fix Memory Delete on web: in app/(tabs)/memory.tsx onDelete, use window.confirm when Platform.OS === 'web' (or render a themed confirm modal). Then memory-delete-{id} will trigger the API and the 'Memory deleted.' toast. This is the only remaining functional bug from this iteration.
(Optional UX) Consider auto-scrolling primary CTAs into view on screen mount, or pinning them as sticky footers above the tab bar so they're tappable without manual scroll on small viewports.

rca_of_issue: Memory delete on web — root cause: react-native-web's polyfill for Alert.alert only supports a single-button alert (window.alert). When called with multiple buttons + onPress callbacks (Cancel + Delete in memory.tsx), the multi-button path is silently dropped and the destructive onPress is NEVER invoked. Reproduction: visit /memory on web at 390x844, tap memory-delete-{id}; observe (a) no native dialog event fires (page.on('dialog', ...) captures zero events), (b) no toast appears, (c) the card stays. Mitigation options: (1) use Platform.OS guard — `if (Platform.OS === 'web') { if (window.confirm(`Delete "${card.nickname}"?`)) onDelete(); }` else fall back to Alert.alert; (2) replace Alert.alert with a custom themed confirm modal that works on all platforms (also better UX/branding); (3) use the cross-platform library 'react-native-paper' Dialog or similar. Option (1) is the smallest change.
